title: Measure Fargate cold start with the larger runner image and add an ECR lifecycle rule
description: The runner image grew from 688 MB to 898 MB with the RISC-V toolchain. Measure session cold start before and after, and add an ECR lifecycle rule (or cdk gc) so old CDK image assets do not accumulate; keep idle cost under 1 USD per month.
right_now_summary: The team needs to measure cold-start impact and add ECR cleanup while keeping idle cost below $1 monthly.
